apps.name: SideInstaller
apps.subtitle: An an app that installs Sidestore on iOS 27, fully on-device
apps.localizedDescription: Install SideStore and LiveContainer directly on your iPhone. No PC required.
apps.versionDescription:
# Main changes:
- Fixed Apple ID sign-in failing with error -80046 ("This action cannot be completed at this time") after entering the verification code
    - SideInstaller now signs in through Mac anisette servers, starting with "SideStore (New)", and reports a current Mac through them, the fix SideStore users found
    - The first sign-in makes a new anisette identity, so Apple asks for your verification code once more
    - With Auto, the Android anisette servers are no longer tried, since Apple refuses to finish signing in through them
- SideStore installed by SideInstaller now signs in out of the box: its on-device anisette and auto-rotation are turned off and "SideStore (New)" is picked. If it still fails, use Reset adi.pb in SideStore's Settings › User Customizations, with "Keep header customizations" unticked
- Added Korean, thanks to [kes158](https://github.com/kes158) (#85)

## Fixes:
- If Apple won't send the code by text, it's now sent to your Apple devices instead
- A slow or failing anisette server no longer holds up sign-in
- "jkcoxson (Windows ADI)" and "StikStore (Windows ADI)" now show as Mac servers, which they've become, and "iLoader (Mac ADI)" was added
